messages:
Ava: Quick design check — I pushed a mini-proto for a compact roles grid + invite rail. TL;DR: make invite drawer a left rail, keep roles matrix full-width. Link: https://figma.com/file/xyz (proto)
Marco: Left rail makes sense for one-hand flows, but does it conflict with workspace nav? can we collapse it at <768px?
Priya: Agree on collapse. Also SSO toggle — moving it inline with org-settings header hides it from keyboard users. Maybe keep it in the access panel.
DesignBot: Accessibility note: ensure SSO toggle has aria-checked and focus ring. Contrast check: #767676 on #ffffff fails.
Ava: Good catch. Quick copy tweak: change “Enforce SSO” to “Require SSO for all members” — clearer in audit logs.
Sam: Audit log nav: suggestion to add “jump to user” search shortcut (/) and keyboard shortcut to skip entries — small patch in frontend.
Jules: UX nit: roles matrix density — adding "compact" toggle under view options instead of global settings?
Marco: If compact view hides hover tips, we need a persistent help icon with tooltip accessible via keyboard.
Priya: For invites: success toast currently sits under rail and overlaps with invite form on mobile. Move to top-right toast area.
Ava: Ok action items: 1) Priya to update keyboard nav for SSO toggle + audit jump (owner: Priya) 2) Marco to prototype collapsed rail <768 (owner: Marco) 3) Jules to add compact toggle copy (owner: Jules) 4) Sam to fix toast placement (owner: Sam)
Sam: I'll open issues and link PRs. ETA EOD Wednesday.
Ava: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
